comparison.objective: Move an empty kanban bin to a reorder shelf and advance the full rear bin to the lane front.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered extraction and placement of two rigid bins.
comparison.success_condition: Empty bin on reorder shelf and full bin at the front; wrong-bin placement, an empty bin left in-lane, or a fall fails. Detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: It tests ordered inventory movement and signaling, not mechanical adjustment or dynamic performance validation.
